 <div dmwrapped="true" id="dmFirstContainer" class="dmBody u_dmStyle_template_activities dm-home-page" themewaschanged="true"> <div id="allWrapper" class="allWrapper" data-auto="all-wrapper"> <div id="dm_content" class="dmContent" role="main"> <div dm:templateorder="170" class="dmHomeRespTmpl mainBorder dmRespRowsWrapper dmFullRowRespTmpl" id="1716942098"> <div class="u_1306379224 dmRespRow hasBackgroundOverlay dmSectionParallaxNew" style="text-align: center;" id="1306379224"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1279802873"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1706709642 medium-12 large-12" id="1706709642"> <div class="imageWidget align-center dm-icon-w_image" data-placeholder="true" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1203408733"><img src="" alt="" id="1468537152" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <span id="1913310021"></span> 
 <div class="u_1546442857 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1546442857"> <h1 class="size-45 m-size-36"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';" class="font-size-45 m-font-size-36">Where the road ends, adventure begins.</span></h1> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1750729151 dmRespRow mobile-columns-reversed" id="1750729151"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1911984559"> <div class="u_1570974242 dmRespCol small-12 medium-12 large-12" id="1570974242"> <div class="u_1266468927 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1266468927" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><strong style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:bold;display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Wind</strong></h2> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1347485808 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1347485808"><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Whether you&rsquo;re into kiting, wing foiling or windsurfing, La Ventana is an endless windy playground. The bay&rsquo;s shape is great for beginners while also delivering exciting conditions for intermediate and expert riders. Todo Bien offers an easy beach launch, making access to the water quick and convenient.</span></p><p style="line-height: 1;"><br/></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">To arrange lessons, email us before your stay and we&rsquo;ll connect you with trusted local instructors. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance to ensure availability.</span></p><p style="line-height: 1;"><br/></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">The primary wind season runs November through April, with the strongest and most consistent winds typically November 15&ndash;March 15. Wing and foil riders can expect rideable conditions across an even wider range of dates.</span></p><p style="line-height: 1;"><br/></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Winter water temperatures average 21&ndash;25&deg;C (70&ndash;74&deg;F). A 4/3 wetsuit is recommended for longer sessions in January and February, while a 3/2 works well most days. From March through November, warmer water means a shorty or swimsuit is usually sufficient. Experienced riders rarely use booties, though beginners may prefer them for added comfort.</span></p></div> 
 <div class="u_1488079020 dmPhotoGallery newPhotoGallery dmPhotoGalleryResp photo-gallery-done text-layout-fixed captionAlignment-center_center photoGallery" galleryoptionsparams="{thumbnailsPerRow: 3, rowsToShow: 3, imageScaleMethod: true}" data-desktop-layout="asymetric2" data-desktop-columns="2" data-element-type="dPhotoGalleryId" data-desktop-text-layout="fixed" id="1488079020" data-placeholder="false" data-rows-to-show="1" data-desktop-caption-alignment="center_center"> <div class="dmPhotoGalleryHolder clearfix gallery shadowEffectToChildren gallery4inArow" id="1362986591"></div>

 <div class="u_1404502033 dmRespRow mobile-columns-reversed" id="1404502033"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1837781864"> <div class="u_1292684413 dmRespCol small-12 medium-12 large-12" id="1292684413"> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1234258548" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1234258548" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><strong style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:bold;display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Ocean</strong></h2> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1863009186" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1863009186" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="text-align-center m-size-19 size-24" style="letter-spacing: 0.3px;"><span class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">&nbsp;The Sea of Cortez is the most biologically diverse body of water on earth</span></p><p class="text-align-center m-size-19 size-24" style="letter-spacing: 0.3px;"><span class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">including the widest variety of whales and dolphins.</span><span class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmRespRow u_1104677006" style="text-align: center;" id="1104677006" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1371821896"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1057635867"> <div class="u_1928040937 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1928040937"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1629968043" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1629968043"> <a id="1997256582"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/SUP-800x533-1-1920w.jpg" alt="Man paddleboarding in ocean, wearing sunglasses and hat, holding a paddle." id="1068366992" height="533" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/SUP-800x533-1.jpg" width="800" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></a> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1128101147" id="1128101147" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Snorkel &amp; Stand Up Paddling (SUP)</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1882228475" id="1882228475" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;" data-version="5"><p class="m-size-16 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-16" style="font-weight:normal;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Todo Bien offers complimentary paddle boards, kayaks, and snorkel gear directly in front of the hotel. Mornings and summer months typically bring clear, calm water, ideal for exploring and observing marine life. We recommend paddling north first for an easier return with the wind at your back.&nbsp;</span><span class="m-font-size-16" style="background-color: transparent; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
 <div class="u_1142666803 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1142666803"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1819523164" data-widget-type="image" id="1819523164" data-element-type="image"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/pangas-800x533-1-768x512-1920w.jpg" id="1660513247" height="512" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/pangas-800x533-1-768x512.jpg" width="768" alt="Boy on a small boat holding a fish, near shore. Clear blue water, sunny day." onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1939379130 dmNewParagraph" id="1939379130" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Pangas (boating)</span> 
</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="u_1801614505 dmNewParagraph" id="1801614505" style="line-height:initial;" data-version="5"><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Whether you enjoy fishing, searching for whales, marine life, exploring secluded beaches, or snorkeling with sea lions, we encourage you to get on the water with one of our trusted local panga captains. We&rsquo;ll set it up, and you&rsquo;ll get picked up on the beach in front of the hotel. Ask about pre-packaged lunches and coolers to take on the boat.</span></p><p class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
 <div class="u_1537859695 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1537859695"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1216253230" data-widget-type="image" id="1216253230" data-element-type="image"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/scuba-800x533-1-768x512-1920w.jpg" id="1804531392" height="512" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/scuba-800x533-1-768x512.jpg" width="768" alt="Scuba diver in shorts, finned, swims underwater above ocean floor, bubbles rise, blue water." onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1821331190" id="1821331190" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Spearfishing, Freediving, Scuba</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1299284021" id="1299284021" style="line-height:initial;" data-version="5"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Explore La Ventana&rsquo;s underwater world, where clear waters, abundant marine life, and warm seas create ideal conditions for spearfishing, freediving, and scuba. From beginners to experienced divers, we can connect you with local operators for unforgettable ocean experiences.</span></p><p class="text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1474035000 dmRespRow" style="text-align: center;" id="1474035000" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1371821896" data-anim-desktop="none"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1155929498"> <div class="u_1010476620 dmRespCol small-12 large-4 medium-4" id="1010476620"> <div class="u_1218124453 imageWidget align-center" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1218124453"> <a id="1916252201"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/cah-whale-1-1920w.png" alt="Whale shark swims underwater; dark body with white spots, in turquoise water." id="1197330940" height="532" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/cah-whale-1.png" width="800" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></a> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1354927247" id="1354927247" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Whales</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="u_1152621935 dmNewParagraph" id="1152621935" style="line-height:initial;" data-version="5"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">On any given day, whales, dolphins, turtles, and rays migrate through La Ventana Bay. Join a day trip with a local guide and watch for blue, fin, sperm, and humpback whales, along with orcas and other species. Our team will arrange the boat and captain, with beach pickup directly in front of the hotel.</span></p></div></div> 
 <div class="u_1536753732 dmRespCol small-12 dmSectionNoParallax large-4 medium-4" id="1536753732" data-gallery-bg="eyJzbGlkZXMiOltdfQ=="> <div class="u_1885641974 imageWidget align-center hasFullWidth" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1885641974"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/Killer-Whale-18f80e2c-248d2e91-1920w.png" alt="Person snorkeling near a large orca whale in blue ocean water." id="1561200339" class="" width="800" height="532" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/Killer-Whale-18f80e2c-248d2e91.png" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1606269950 dmNewParagraph" id="1606269950" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;" data-version="5"><p class="size-32 text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-32" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Swimming with Orcas</span></p></div> <div class="u_1239202697 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1239202697" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">La Ventana is one of only two places in the world where swimming with orcas is legally permitted.</span></p><p style="line-height: 0.5;" class="text-align-justify"><br/></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">A small number of locally operated boats carry the proper permits to take people out to respectfully observe these animals. While encounters are never guaranteed, La Ventana&rsquo;s calm, crystal-clear blue waters and warm ocean temperatures, especially in summer, offer an extraordinary opportunity to witness orcas in their natural environment</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1653019912 dmRespCol small-12 large-4 medium-4" id="1653019912"> <div class="u_1057312631 imageWidget align-center" data-widget-type="image" id="1057312631" data-element-type="image"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/What-is-Tow-Foiling-8fb4c4a7-1920w.png" id="1411701380" height="384" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/What-is-Tow-Foiling-8fb4c4a7.png" width="581" alt="Beach scene with mountains, blue water, and birds on rocks." onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1742605265 dmNewParagraph" id="1742605265" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">E-foiling &amp; Boat Towing</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1887659378" id="1887659378" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;" data-version="5"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">On calm mornings or non-windy days, e-foil rentals and towing sessions offer the perfect way to refine your foiling skills. E-foiling or boat-foiling is an ideal introduction to wing foiling, helping you build balance and confidence on the foil before adding wind to the experience.</span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmRespRow u_1610291270 dmSectionParallaxNew hasBackgroundOverlay" id="1610291270"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1053938979"> <div class="u_1394550433 dmRespCol empty-column small-12 medium-12 large-12" id="1394550433"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1618975721 dmRespRow mobile-columns-reversed" id="1618975721"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1179724627"> <div class="u_1363789431 dmRespCol small-12 medium-12 large-12" id="1363789431"> <div class="u_1038786820 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1038786820" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><strong style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:bold;display:unset;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Land</strong></h2> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1021911836" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1021911836" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="text-align-center m-size-19 size-24" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;You&rsquo;ll be charmed by local culture, awed by scenic mountains, and calmed by the desert&nbsp; &nbsp;landscape. The area boasts an incredible network of trails and over 100 species of cacti alone.</span><span class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div>

 <div class="dmRespRow u_1055447525" style="text-align: center;" id="1055447525" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1371821896"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1890592598"> <div class="u_1022487930 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1022487930"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1545588952" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1545588952"> <a id="1426913532"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/mountainbike-cardon-800x533-1-1920w.jpg" alt="Woman on a mountain bike rides past a large tree on a desert trail; blue shirt, shorts." id="1312667831" height="533" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/mountainbike-cardon-800x533-1.jpg" width="800" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></a> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1696454921" id="1696454921" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Mountain Biking</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1240656887" id="1240656887" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;" data-version="5"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Explore 70+ miles of bike trails using the Trailforks app for easy navigation. We can recommend local rental shops and encourage you to consider an e-bike to cover more terrain. Southern trails are well-suited for beginner to intermediate riders, while northern routes offer more advanced riding. For an all-day guided experience, look at</span><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">&nbsp;</span> 
</span><a href="https://www.ranchocacachilas.com/day-tours" target="_blank" runtime_url="https://www.ranchocacachilas.com/day-tours" type="url" style="color:var(--color_1);font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;"><strong>Rancho Cacachilas.</strong></a></p><p style="letter-spacing: 0.3px;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
 <div class="u_1176487085 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1176487085"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1266485886" data-widget-type="image" id="1266485886" data-element-type="image"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/hiking-1920w.png" id="1906827634" height="533" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/hiking.png" width="800" alt="Red finch perched on a palm frond, against a pale blue sky." onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1604868130 dmNewParagraph" id="1604868130" style="transition: none; display: block; text-align: left;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Hiking &amp; Trail Running</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="u_1985761442 dmNewParagraph" id="1985761442" data-version="5" data-styletopreserve="{" background-image":""}"=""><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">The Punta Gorda Trail winds through the cactus forest north of town, offering beautiful views of the island along the way. The trail ends at the water, where you can enjoy a refreshing swim. The trailhead is a 15&ndash;20-minute drive from the hotel, and the hike typically takes 2&ndash;3 hours self-guided. The trailhead location can be found on</span> 
</span><a href="https://www.trailforks.com/tracker/map/?ping=24.133378828177015,-110.0015204274467" target="_blank" runtime_url="https://www.trailforks.com/tracker/map/?ping=24.133378828177015,-110.0015204274467" type="url" style="color:var(--color_1);font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;"><strong>Trailforks.</strong></a></p><p style="line-height: normal;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p style="line-height: normal;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-left" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div> 
 <div class="u_1205180843 dmRespCol small-12 medium-4 large-4" id="1205180843"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1134142894" data-widget-type="image" id="1134142894" data-element-type="image"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/opt/massage-800x533-1-768x512-1920w.jpg" id="1170985169" height="512" class="" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/fab44011/dms3rep/multi/massage-800x533-1-768x512.jpg" width="768" alt="Person receiving back massage in a spa setting with candles and flowers." onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1812520995 dmNewParagraph" id="1812520995" style="transition-duration: 1s; transition-timing-function: ease-in-out; transition-delay: initial; transition-property: opacity; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);font-weight:400;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Massage &amp; Body Work</span></h2> 
</div> <div class="u_1591674015 dmNewParagraph" id="1591674015" style="line-height:initial;" data-version="5"><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Unwind with a personalized massage designed to balance movement, breath, and deep relaxation.  <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1677423497" id="1677423497" style="transition: none; display: block; text-align: left;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h2 class="text-align-center"><span style="text-shadow:none;color:var(--color_7);display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Yoga</span></h2>

A short walk from the hotel, featuring organic foods and local arts &amp; crafts.</span></span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div></div>

 <div class="photoGalleryViewAll link" data-auto="photo-gallery-view-all" isall="true" data-viewall="View more" data-viewless="View less">View more</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1850836327" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1850836327" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Mule Rides:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Rancho Cacachiles, about a 20 minute drive from the hotel, offers mule rides for all ages, followed by a farm to table lunch.</span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><a href="https://www.ranchocacachilas.com/day-tours" target="_blank" runtime_url="https://www.ranchocacachilas.com/day-tours" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">https://www.ranchocacachilas.com/day-tours</a></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Giant Card&oacute;n Forest:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Drive approximately 30 minutes south around the bay to find a</span> 
</span><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="color:var(--color_1);font-weight:bold;display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Forest of Giant Card&oacute;n</strong><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">&nbsp;</span> 
</span><span style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">cacti, the tallest growing cacti in the world, only found in Baja California and Sonora.These massive Card&oacute;ns have tapped into an aquifer. They have heights over 60 feet, weigh up to 25 tons and can live over 300 years. Finding the forest of giant card&oacute;ns can be tricky. Driving out of La Ventana, take a left toward Los Planes (instead of a right toward La Paz). Drive through the town of Los Planes and when the road begins to curve left around the bay, continue straight onto a dirt road instead of curving left. Then take your first right on another dirt road and drive south for about 10 minutes and you will start seeing the giants.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Swim with the Whale Sharks:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">For a unique full-day experience, travel 45 minutes by car to La Paz and snorkel with the world&rsquo;s largest fish. Whale Sharks can reach lengths of more than 40 feet and live up to 70 years. Juvenile whale sharks come to the Bay of La Paz from October to February each year. Swimming with whale sharks is a safe activity for all ages. Let the front desk help arrange this activity for you.&nbsp;</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Lighthouse Beach:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Venture across the bay to discover Lighthouse Beach, a beautiful, uncrowded stretch of coastline perfect for a refreshing swim. To get there, turn left onto the main road and follow it to the end, then turn left again. Continue through the town of Los Planes, staying left as the road winds around the bay. After about 25 minutes, you&rsquo;ll see a guard gate on your left. Turn there and follow the dirt road all the way to the lighthouse and the water.</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">Balandra Bay:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">Just beyond La Paz, Balandra Bay is consistently ranked among the most beautiful beaches in the world. Pristine white sand meets calm, crystal-clear water, creating ideal swimming conditions, especially for families, thanks to the bay&rsquo;s shallow, protected shoreline. Arrive early, as visitor numbers are sometimes capped. When wading in shallow water, always remember to shuffle your feet along the sand to allow rays time to move and avoid accidental contact.&nbsp;</span></p><p class="text-align-justify"><span class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';"><br/></span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify"><strong class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14" style="font-weight:bold;display:initial;text-decoration:underline;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';">El Triunfo:</strong></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18 text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display:initial;font-family:Arial, 'Arial Fallback';font-style:normal;">About a 45-minute drive from the hotel, El Triunfo is a historic mining town tucked into the mountains of Southern Baja. Once nearly forgotten, this charming village is enjoying a quiet renaissance, with beautifully restored colonial buildings, small museums, inviting caf&eacute;s and restaurants, and the occasional lively festival that brings its storied past back to life.</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="sticky-widgets-container-global" id="1274624917"></div> 
 <div class="dmFooterContainer"> <div id="fcontainer" class="u_fcontainer f_hcontainer dmFooter p_hfcontainer"> <div dm:templateorder="250" class="dmFooterResp generalFooter" id="1943048428"> <div class="u_1898626460 dmRespRow" id="1898626460"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1896467429"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1226448943 medium-4 large-4" id="1226448943"> <div class="u_1952677645 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1952677645" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s; text-align: left;"><p><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: bold;">LOCATION</strong></p></div> 
 <div class="u_1953920576 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1953920576" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;" new-inline-bind-applied="true" data-diy-text=""><p class="m-text-align-center"><span style="display: initial;"><span class="inline-data-binding" data-encoded-value="Q29ycmVkb3IgSXNsYSBDZXJyYWx2bywgMjMyMzIgTGEgUGF6LCBCYWphIENhbGlmb3JuaWEgU3VyLCBNZXhpY28=" data-inline-binding="content_library.global" data-inline-binding-encoded="Y29udGVudF9saWJyYXJ5Lmdsb2JhbA==">Corredor Isla Cerralvo, 23232 La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico</span></span></p><p class="m-text-align-center"><a href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/y7zMewr65m2bzooo7" target="_blank" runtime_url="https://maps.app.goo.gl/y7zMewr65m2bzooo7" type="url" style="display: initial;">Google maps</a></p></div> 
 <div class="u_1703879172 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1703879172" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"><p><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: bold;">HOURS</strong></p></div> 
 <div class="u_1467632689 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1467632689" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-center m-size-15 size-16"><span class="font-size-16 m-font-size-15" m-font-size-set="true" style="display: initial;">Reception: 8am - 8pm</span></p><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-center m-size-15 size-16"><span class="font-size-16 m-font-size-15" m-font-size-set="true" style="display: initial;">Check-in: after 3pm</span></p><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-center m-size-15 size-16"><span class="font-size-16 m-font-size-15" m-font-size-set="true" style="display: initial;">Check-out: before 11am</span></p></div> 
</div>
